description:
Welcome to my channel! Here we learn the basics of electrical work through discussions and hands-on demonstrations covering everything from receptacles and troubleshooting to conduit bending and much more. I frequently reference the National Electrical Code (NEC) and demonstrate proper, code-compliant methods.

DISCLAIMER: All content on this channel is provided for educational, informational, and entertainment purposes only. Electrical work can result in serious injury, death, fire, or property damage if performed improperly. Always follow applicable codes, laws, manufacturer instructions, and proper safety procedures. Use appropriate PPE and never attempt work beyond your knowledge or ability. Consult a qualified professional when necessary. By using information from this channel, you accept responsibility for your own actions, safety, and results.
